desired.title: Verify final readiness and refresh local recovery
desired.body: Final research, native-code and outgoing-Git reviews found no remaining product defect. Refreshed local repository recovery at a73b6dc and preserved the exact build 21 app; archive and separate restore pass. These are same-volume copy-on-write copies with shared physical extents, not independent-device backup. Ten absolute aliases in a failed harness were relocated only in the archival view; original targets and the rejected first attempt remain retained. Eleven historical daily/weekly replays, three bounded checkpoints and closeout pass; day11 keeps its expected refusal and unchanged 5,088-ID ledger. The restored Python run exposed a historical test path dependency; test-only repair a4eedd7 passes all 406 tests in the new restore, together with the synthetic CLI, package and two scripted runner examples under network/original-path denial. Frozen research evidence, human build 20 review and published 0.14 remain unchanged. Prepared named-branch publication on codex/research-closeout; merging, human acceptance, app release and Being rollout remain separate. Evidence: analyses/2026-10-07-final-readiness-and-recovery.md; board/2026-10-07-final-readiness.json
